instruction: I maintain a log of my monthly venmo expense in SimpleNote note. Update it with an entry for this month.
notes: Apps: supervisor, simple_note (PDDL constant simple-note), venmo. Flow: get passwords, log in to SimpleNote, find the 'Venmo Expenses' log note, read its content to learn the entry format and month ordering, log in to Venmo, fetch this month's sent transactions (direction=sent, May 2023 window; paginate at runtime and sum amounts), then update the note content with the new '- 05/23 => $X' entry placed in the existing order. simple_note.update_note is used with only note_id/access_token/content so title and pinned stay unchanged (add_content_to_note is avoided because prepending would break the '# Venmo Expenses' header). Runtime values (passwords, tokens, note id, expense total, new content) are placeholder objects; static init facts tie the content object to the note, month and amount. supervisor-complete-task carries the note/content as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the task goal; it is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on every other action.

plan: (venmo-show-transactions venmo-token direction-sent datetime-2023-05-01t00-00-00 datetime-2023-05-31t23-59-59 month-05-23 amount-total-sent-05-23)
